hero.headline: Recovery-focused group programming for people living with serious mental illness and their families
hero.body: Wise Recovery offers a series of in-person, psychiatrist-led group sessions for people living with serious mental illness and their families. Sessions combine education, discussion, practical guidance, and advocacy around serious mental illness, treatment, recovery, and navigating the mental health system.
hero.byline: Created by psychiatrist Monica Slubicki, MD, the programs draw on her experience both providing psychiatric care and living with serious mental illness herself.

education.headline: Understanding serious mental illness changes everything.
education.col1: Wise Recovery programs are built on the belief that education is a cornerstone of recovery. When people living with serious mental illness — and the families who support them — understand what they are facing, they are better equipped to navigate treatment, advocate for themselves, and build meaningful lives.
education.col2: Our sessions address the full landscape of serious mental illness: what it is, how it is treated, what recovery looks like, and how to work effectively with the mental health system. We bring clinical expertise and lived experience together in a format that is accessible, honest, and grounded in hope.

featured.label: Featured Program
featured.title: Wise Recovery Transitions
featured.subtitle: A group program for people returning to everyday life after psychiatric hospitalization.
featured.body: Psychiatric hospitalization is a significant event. Returning home can feel disorienting, uncertain, and isolating. Wise Recovery Transitions is designed specifically for this moment — providing structured group support, practical education, and a community of people who understand what you are going through.

bullets.text: Designed for the post-hospitalization transition period
Combines education, discussion, and peer connection
Addresses medication, treatment, and recovery planning
Led by a psychiatrist with clinical and lived experience
Available for individuals and through healthcare organizations

organizations.headline: Bring Wise Recovery groups to your organization
organizations.body: Wise Recovery programs are designed to be delivered within healthcare and community settings. We work with hospitals, mental health practices, and community organizations to bring structured, psychiatrist-led group programming to the people they serve.

types.title: Hospitals and health systems
types.desc: Inpatient and outpatient programs, transition support, and patient and family education.

types.title: Mental health practices and programs
types.desc: Complement individual treatment with structured group education and recovery support.

types.title: Community and nonprofit organizations
types.desc: Bring evidence-informed programming to the communities you serve.

organizations.collab: We offer consultation, program development, and ongoing collaboration to help organizations implement Wise Recovery groups effectively.

profeducation.headline: For clinicians and healthcare learners
profeducation.body: Wise Recovery offers educational content and programming for clinicians, trainees, and healthcare learners who want to deepen their understanding of serious mental illness, recovery, and patient and family perspectives. Our programs bring together clinical knowledge and lived experience in a way that is rarely available in formal training.
profeducation.note: Continuing education and training opportunities available.

about.name: Monica Slubicki, MD
about.title: Psychiatrist · Founder
about.bio: Monica Slubicki, MD is a psychiatrist who founded Wise Recovery to bring together her clinical expertise and her own lived experience with serious mental illness. She created Wise Recovery because she believes that people living with serious mental illness — and the families who love them — deserve access to honest, practical, psychiatrist-led education and support.

contact.headline: Questions about Wise Recovery?
contact.body: We welcome inquiries from individuals, families, clinicians, and organizations. Whether you are exploring programs for yourself or a loved one, or interested in bringing Wise Recovery to your organization, we would be glad to hear from you.
